latest_release.name: v0.4.0
latest_release.body:
# TorchTitan 0.4.0

TorchTitan 0.4.0 aligns with PyTorch 2.15, expands model coverage, improves large-scale MoE training, and unifies core training and TitanRL on a shared engine.

These highlights cover changes since 0.3.0. For broader updates and benchmarks, see [TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL](https://pytorch.org/blog/torchtitan-update-new-sota-models-performance-at-scale-titanrl/).

## New model implementations

- **Muse Spark Open:** Adds the 816B-A42B model, including text and vision/audio configurations. Multimodal CUDA graphs remain unsupported. ([#5420](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5420))
- **Kimi K3:** Hybrid KDA/MLA attention, LatentMoE, and vision support, with tensor/sequence and expert parallelism plus a dedicated pipeline implementation for attention residuals. ([#4025](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4025), [#4312](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4312))
- **DeepSeek V4:** Initial Flash/Pro support with sparse attention, indexer loss, optional multi-token prediction, and debug recipes. Full-scale checkpoint and convergence validation remain outstanding. ([#3634](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/3634), [#4835](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4835))

## Training performance and memory

- **Dist-MoE integration:** Fuses expert dispatch, computation, and combine. DeepSeek V3 BF16/MXFP8 recipes for NVIDIA SM100+ GPUs include fused MLA and SwiGLU. ([#4541](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4541), [#4542](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4542))
- **Low-precision training:** MXFP8 gains FSDP-managed prepared weights and fused weight-gradient accumulation across microbatches. Experimental NVFP4 support extends to grouped MoE linear layers. Both paths require supported Blackwell hardware and their respective optional dependencies. ([#4203](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4203), [#4911](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4911), [#4821](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4821))
- **Local compilation:** `model.local_compile_regions` selects functions such as SwiGLU, RoPE, and gated RMSNorm for independent compilation and kernel fusion with `torch.compile`. ([#4894](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4894), [#4931](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4931), [#4985](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4985), [#5026](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5026))
- **Faster router and LM-head layers:** `HiMidLoLinear` uses BF16 matrix multiplications with FP32 outputs. Its backward pass combines two or three BF16 parts of each FP32 output gradient, improving accuracy over a single BF16 cast. ([#4923](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4923))
- **CUDA graphs and pipeline memory:** Adds pipeline forward/backward capture, shared training/validation graph memory, and per-microbatch-group replay, plus controls for FSDP parameter residency and unshard lookahead. ([#4493](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4493), [#5241](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5241), [#4592](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4592))
- **Context parallelism:** Adds Ulysses support for standard and variable-length attention, improves MLA communication, and adds native context-parallel paths for Qwen3.5 Gated DeltaNet and Kimi K3 KDA. ([#4450](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4450), [#4760](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4760), [#5184](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5184))
- **Activation rematerialization:** `torch_remat` controls activation saving and recomputation by region. DeepEP dispatch preserves token order during recomputation, preventing incorrect MoE gradients. ([#4497](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/4497), [#5115](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5115))
- **FlexShard / DistMuon:** Extends optimizer-compute layouts with variable-sized `BlockShard` partitions and BF16 redistribution
